name: Geographica
description: a vertical short-form video series about places, their borders and the stories they hold, told with animated maps

voice.instructions: Warm, curious storyteller walking a friend across a map. Clear and confident, with a sense of discovery on each reveal; slow slightly on dates and place names so they land. Conversational and human, never a documentary announcer, lecture, or neutral TTS. Never imitate a known person or character.

notices.ownership: Maps drawn from Natural Earth data (public domain). Facts are cited in the sources below.
notices.nonAffiliation: Geographica is an independent educational series. Borders and names follow Natural Earth's de facto view; disputed areas are marked as such.
